faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar XKR-S use?
faqLeft.a: The XKR-S uses the 5.0-litre supercharged AJ133 V8, fitted from 2012 to 2014 across the X150 generation. It's the highest-output version of Jaguar's AJ133 engine family.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar XKR-S engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £5,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my XKR-S?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the AJ133 engine and match the rebuild accordingly.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ133 XKR-S engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain assemblies, tensioners, guides and the water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used XKR-S engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my XKR-S if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an XKR-S engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most XKR-S owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
